paper_title: Upper limit on the axion-photon coupling from magnetic white dwarf polarization
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Astrophysical bound from magnetic white dwarf polarization (not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density). Conservative fiducial 95% upper limit |g_agamma| <= 5.4e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a <= 3e-7 eV from SDSS J135141. The bound is approximately mass-independent below ~3e-7 eV (encoded as horizontal line up to the stated validity edge) and degrades as ~m_a^2 above. Grw+70 8247 and other MWDs give weaker limits.
